why: Two colour-token decisions (#312) that Button cannot make for itself. The set may shrink and must never grow: an entry that stops failing is itself reported, so a fix cannot be made and then quietly forgotten here.

notes.warning/filled: --color-on-warning (#ffffff) on --color-warning (#9f8205) measures 3.70:1, the only one of the 40 generated combinations under 4.5:1. Needs a darker filled warning ground, or filled warning disallowed. #268.
notes.info+tertiary: --color-info is literally `var(--color-tertiary)` in _colors.scss, and so is every other info slot. Two names, one appearance. Needs info re-pointed, merged into tertiary, or tertiary moved. #268.
